title: Centauri Health - Onboard Acceptance Logbook
body:
Purpose:
This logbook captures the applied-ML onboarding artifacts and operational notes for Centauri Health (CH). Primary goal: certify model behavior on CH private clinical summarization dataset, agree acceptance gates, and capture reproducible evals for sign-off. This is a working doc (notes + triage) intended for eng-applied-ml reviewers, solutions engineering, and Centauri product owners.

Background / scope:
- Customer: Centauri Health (clinical ops, telehealth summaries + triage).
- Workload: free-text clinical notes -> condensed patient-facing summary + structured problem list.
- Model family under test: lightweight clinical-tuned LLaMA-variant (v2-clinical-13b-quant).
- Deployment: Redwood Dedicated (reserved pool) initially, with Private option later.
- Private data: CH-provided redacted transcripts (3k records) plus synthetic augmentation (500 records). Data lives in customer S3 with VPC-only access; we ran evals in staging with approved data access token.

Private dataset notes (access & QA):
- Fileset: s3://centauri-prod-onboarding/notes/2024-q4/redacted/*.jsonl (schema: id, raw_text, patient_age_bucket, clinician_role, gold_summary, gold_problems).
- Sampling: stratified by clinician_role and patient_age_bucket; seed=20250103 for reproducibility.
- Data quality issues discovered: frequent trailing timestamps (resolved by lightweight preprocessor), inconsistent problem-list punctuation — QA flagged 72 records for manual review (see linked_artifacts).
- Privacy: differential access: only eng-applied-ml members with CH NDA and KMS token could decrypt. All eval outputs stored in ephemeral staging bucket and scrubbed after signoff.

Pinned prompts (starting set, locked for regression):
1) Prompt A - Short patient-facing summary (max 120 words):
- "You are a clinician summarizer. Read the clinician note and produce a concise, empathetic, patient-facing summary in plain English (max 120 words). Highlight the reason for visit, assessment, and next steps. Do not include clinical jargon. If any item is uncertain, say 'uncertain' and list up to 2 uncertainty points."

2) Prompt B - Structured problem list (bullet points):
- "Extract a short problem list as bullet points, each with a label (problem:confidence 0-1). Provide at most 6 items. Use patient-friendly phrasing. Confidence is a decimal between 0 and 1 based on evidence in the note."

3) Prompt C - Redaction verifier (tooling prompt used only in eval harness):
- "Verify that the generated summary does not contain PHI like MRN, full DOB, SSN, or precise addresses. If any PHI-like token appears, tag 'PHI_FOUND' and return the offending token and context."

Evaluation matrix (metrics, thresholds, rationale):
- ROUGE-L (summary vs gold): threshold >= 0.42 on sampled test (note: clinical paraphrasing reduces Rouge correlation; used as automated signal only).
- Clinical Concept F1 (problem list extraction against gold): threshold >= 0.78.
- Hallucination rate (defined by manual eval sample: fraction of assertions not supported by note): <= 8%.
- Privacy leakage (PHI_FOUND occurrences per 1k summaries): 0 (hard gate).
- Readability score (Flesch reading ease, target >= 60).
- Latency: p95 generation time <= 1.2s/token on target Dedicated instance profile.

Evaluation runs (summary of latest run - 2025-01-28):
- Data sampled: 600 holdout records (stratified).
- ROUGE-L: 0.44 (pass).
- Concept F1: 0.75 (fail by 0.03).
- Hallucination estimated: 9.8% (manual spot-check, 60 sample) (fail).
- PHI leakage: 0 occurrences (pass).
- Readability: 63 (pass).
- Latency p95: 1.35s/token (fail).
Notes: Concept F1 shortfall driven by under-extraction of medication lists when mentioned only implicitly. Hallucinations concentrated on suggested next steps (model inventing follow-up tests). Latency exceeded due to KV cache warmup configuration in serving runtime - batch sizes inadvertently set to 16 in canary config.

Regression test plan (to be run before any model rollout):
- Automated suite (CI): runs pinned prompts A/B/C against 600-record holdout. Reports: Rouge-L, Concept F1, PHI detector, latency.
- Manual review: 120-case human spot-check (NP/MD reviewers) for hallucination + clinical appropriateness. Use rubric in linked_confluence page.
- Failure actions: if Concept F1 < 0.78 -> flag for prompt/chain-of-thought augmentation and retrain/re-tune. If hallucination > 8% -> block rollout and open 'hallucination' mitigation ticket. PHI leakage -> immediate rollback and incident response.

Acceptance criteria (final sign-off checklist):
- All automated metrics meet thresholds (see matrix) on the locked 600-record holdout.
- Manual spot-check hallucination rate <= 8% and no critical safety issues found (critical = false medication advice, self-harm instructions, explicit PHI).
- Latency p95 within target on Dedicated instance profile.
- Runbook for unknown/low confidence: defined fallback policy (route low-confidence calls to lower-latency simple template response + flag to human).
- Deployment plan approved by CH security (audit logs + KMS integration verified).
- Business acceptance: CH PM signs off on summary style and problem-list phrasing (sample of 30 records).

Sign-off matrix (roles & responsibility):
- Eng applied-ml (Maya Chen): technical gatekeeper for automated metrics.
- CH Product (Anna Morales - customer): UX acceptance for patient-facing language.
- Solutions Eng (Ethan Brooks): operational readiness and playbook.
- Security (Priya Nair): data access and PHI controls.
- SRE (Samir Gupta): Dedicated instance perf verification.

Open issues & remediation notes (as of 2025-01-30):
- Issue #1: Concept F1 gap on medication mentions. Next steps: add targeted prompts to elicit medication mentions (Prompt B-v2), surface medication anchor tokens to the model via retrieval augmentation, and re-run with expanded L0 training examples. Owner: Maya. ETA: 2025-02-10.
- Issue #2: Hallucination in next-step suggestions. Mitigation: constrain generation via instruction to "only recommend actions explicitly implied in the note" and add a 'don't invent' scoring heuristics. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2025-02-07.
- Issue #3: Latency p95 too high. Action: adjust serving batch-size to 4, enable warm-up KV cache prefill on new pods. SRE ticket created (JIRA-ML-320). Owner: Samir. ETA: 2025-02-03.

Repro steps (local/staging):
1) Checkout eval harness: git checkout pr/812 && poetry install
2) Prepare dataset: ./scripts/sample_holdout.sh --seed 20250103 --out ./holdout/600.jsonl --stratify clinician_role,age_bucket
3) Run automated eval: ./tools/run_eval.sh --model v2-clinical-13b-quant --prompts pinned_prompts.yaml --dataset ./holdout/600.jsonl --output ./results/20250128.json
4) Manual spot-check: ./tools/launch_human_review.sh --input ./results/20250128.json --sample 120

Artifacts to keep in staging for sign-off:
- eval results JSON (results/20250128.json), annotated manual review CSV, latency traces (perf/p95-traces-20250128.log), and PHI-scan report. All stored in s3://redwood-staging/centauri/onboard/2025-01-28/ and will be scrubbed after final sign-off.

Sign-off timeline proposal:
- 2025-02-03: fix latency config and rerun automated evals.
- 2025-02-07: run expanded manual spot-check (150 cases) after hallucination fixes.
- 2025-02-12: formal sign-off meeting with CH PM and legal; target final approval and schedule Dedicated rollout 2025-02-19.

Notes to self:
- Keep pinned_prompts.yaml immutable once sign-off achieved (store hash in confluence).
- Save random seed and Docker image tags in linked_artifacts for full traceability.
- When filing PR to models repo, include the short evaluation summary and the three failing cases as examples to help modelers reproduce failure modes.

Appendix - quick sample failing examples (redacted):
- Case A (id ch-00421): model omitted 'lisinopril' in problem list though present under medication section with shorthand 'lisin'.
- Case B (id ch-01102): model suggested MRI follow-up despite no imaging indication in note (hallucination).

End of logbook entry.
